events.summary: Owner approved 'KISA 수정' (2026-11-24), including minimal read-only RBAC on ClusterRole narwhal-portal for live KISA controls and no new Secret read permission. Added list-only on security.istio.io/peerauthentications (KISA-TLS-01), wgpolicyk8s.io/policyreports (KISA-IMG-02), and cilium.io/ciliumnetworkpolicies (KISA-NET-01/ETCD-02), plus get/list on batch/cronjobs (KISA-SEC-01 get and KISA-IMG-02 list); no secrets rule or ciliumclusterwidenetworkpolicies rule was added.
